summary: Layout matches the wireframe on desktop (rail, sidebar, tabs, main, right bar, bottom bar) and the plain-English tone is good, but the automated 10/10 is misleading: switching clients only updates 4 numbers on Overview while every other tab, the summary, the right bar and the badges keep showing BrightSmile data; the MSP console and the single-business view are mixed into one screen (business owner sees 25 clients, MSP margins and Watchpost's direct price); several numbers contradict each other; the right bar is identical on every tab; and the phone drawers have no scrim or close button.

defects.issue: The owner of one dental group lands on an MSP console: sidebar 'Clients · 25' with Harbor Auto, Sunrise Credit Union etc., avatar 'Signed in as Jordan (MSP)', and a 'Partner' tab showing MSP wholesale cost and 50% margin. Confusing and, under white-label, a commercial leak.
defects.fix: Make two roles: a single-business view (sidebar = their offices/locations, no Partner tab, no client list) and an MSP view. Mockup should open on the owner's view by default, with an MSP switch only for MSP users.

defects.issue: Hero says 'Nothing needs your attention today' while the rail bell shows 2, an incident is 'Action needed', and the right bar lists 3 'Your next actions'. Owner cannot tell whether to act.
defects.fix: Derive the hero from open actions: 'Protected · 1 small task for your team' with a link; only say 'nothing needs your attention' when the action list is empty.

defects.issue: KPI jargon: 'endpoints', 'Median time to contain', 'SLA 30 min', 'Critical patches missing' are exactly the jargon the persona struggles with.
defects.fix: Plain labels: 'Computers protected 60 of 64', 'How fast we stopped threats: 11 min (we promise 30)', 'Security updates still needed: 2 servers'. Keep technical terms in a tooltip.

defects.issue: 'Threats stopped (30 days): 3' does not match what is shown: the summary has 2 real threats and the Incidents list has 2 threats plus 1 benign admin-account check.
defects.fix: Make counts reconcile: either 2 threats stopped, or list all 3 in the summary and Incidents, and exclude 'Confirmed OK' items from the count.

defects.issue: No link between protection and the business outcomes he cares about (insurance renewal, patient-data breach risk). Insurance readiness lives in a separate tab he will not open.
defects.fix: Add a one-line Overview strip: 'Insurance renewal Jan 15: 9 of 10 answers ready' and 'HIPAA: 18 of 20 controls met', each linking to its tab.

defects.issue: Two download buttons for the same report: 'Download monthly report (PDF)' in main and 'October report (PDF)' in the right bar, with different labels and month unclear (summary says 'This month', it is November 11).
defects.fix: One button labelled with the period, e.g. 'October 2026 report (PDF)', and label the summary 'October 1-31' or 'Last 30 days'.

defects.issue: Shield emoji renders as a grey/blue shield even in 'Action needed' state; status colour alone carries meaning.
defects.fix: Use an SVG icon that changes with state (check vs exclamation) and keep the text label.

defects.issue: The incident that actually needs her ('214 failed logins', Action needed) is not opened by default; the auto-opened one is the 'Nothing urgent' incident. Detail appears below the list, far from the clicked row on mobile.
defects.fix: Sort 'Action needed' first and open it by default; on desktop show detail in a side pane or inline under the clicked row (accordion with aria-expanded); on phone open a full-screen detail sheet.

defects.issue: Contradiction in the failed-login incident: sign-ins were 'blocked' yet a password reset was forced; right bar says 'Reset reception@ password (done by us, confirm)' while the incident says 'Confirm with the reception team that they have the new password'. Also the Overview says the attempts came from Nigeria but the incident does not.
defects.fix: Use one wording everywhere: 'We reset the reception@ password after 214 blocked attempts from Nigeria. Your task: give the new password to the reception team (2 min). [Mark done]'.

defects.issue: No way to mark a task done, ask a question about this incident, or see who to call; 'Call the SOC' is generic and the analyst is 'until 18:00 ET', which suggests nobody after hours.
defects.fix: Add 'Mark done' and 'Ask an analyst about this' buttons in the 'What you need to do' box; in the right bar show 'Next analyst: Sam T. 18:00-02:00' to show 24/7 cover.

defects.issue: 'Optional: ... we included a 1-page tip sheet' but there is no link to it.
defects.fix: Add a 'Download tip sheet (PDF)' link inside the box.

defects.issue: Severity is shown only by a coloured dot (red/orange/grey) with no text; 'reception@' is a cryptic address.
defects.fix: Add text severity ('High', 'Medium', 'Info') next to the dot and write the full mailbox 'reception@brightsmile.com'.

defects.issue: On phone the incident list title row is cut off at the top after the detail scrolls into view, and the tab bar hides 'Compliance', 'Insurance', 'Partner' off-screen without a scroll hint.
defects.fix: Use scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) with offset for sticky tabs and add a fade/chevron on the overflowing tab bar or a 'More' menu.

defects.issue: Devices tab is hard-coded to BrightSmile: after switching to Harbor (85/88) or Sunrise (117/120) the list still shows 4 BrightSmile devices; Harbor's Overview says '85/88' but '4 not reporting' (should be 3).
defects.fix: Bind Devices, Incidents, Compliance, Insurance, summary and right bar to the selected org, and compute 'N not reporting' from the device ratio.

defects.issue: 'All devices (64)' shows only 3 rows with no search, filter, sort, pagination or export; Risk column is plain text.
defects.fix: Add search, filters (office, status, OS), sort by risk, 'Showing 3 of 64 · View all', CSV export, and colour/icon the risk level.

defects.issue: Not-reporting list is sorted by days only; NAS-BACKUP offline is the biggest ransomware risk but listed last. No reason (agent stopped, uninstalled, device off).
defects.fix: Sort by impact, tag NAS-BACKUP 'Backup server: high risk', and show the last known reason and last user/IP per device.

defects.issue: 'Send reinstall link to IT' is wrong when the viewer is IT; no agent install/deploy option (GPO, Intune, RMM script).
defects.fix: Label 'Copy agent install command' / 'Deploy via Intune or RMM' for IT users; keep 'Send to IT contact' for non-IT roles.

defects.issue: 'Schedule patch tonight' implies Watchpost patches servers, which a Wazuh-based MDR does not normally do; DC-01 reboot at 1:00 am during a dental practice's backups is risky and has no confirmation.
defects.fix: Clarify who patches ('Create ticket for your IT / send to RMM') or, if offered, show a confirmation with reboot window and rollback note.

defects.issue: 'Critical patches missing: 2' counts servers, not patches (it is one KB on 2 servers); KB5044284 is a client-OS KB, not a Windows Server one.
defects.fix: Say '1 critical update missing on 2 servers' and use a real Server 2022 KB or a placeholder like 'KB50xxxxx'.

defects.issue: Nothing addresses his struggle of alert fatigue: no count of alerts triaged vs escalated, false-positive rate or tuning/suppression controls.
defects.fix: Add an 'Alert noise' card: '1,240 alerts reviewed by analysts → 3 escalated to you', plus 'Suppress / tune rule' on Confirmed-OK incidents.

defects.issue: Rail Search button only shows a toast; no way to search logs or a host.
defects.fix: Open a search panel (host, user, IP, last 30 days) even if mocked with sample results.

defects.issue: Switching client changes only the name, hero and 3 KPIs. The 'This month' summary (Nigeria front-desk, 'Your IT contact'), Incidents, Devices, Compliance (HIPAA for a car dealer), Insurance, right-bar actions and rail badge all stay BrightSmile. A tech would act on the wrong client.
defects.fix: Make every panel, the right bar and the bottom bar data-driven per org; show the selected client name in a persistent header above the tabs.

defects.issue: Sidebar shows 5 of 25 clients; '+ 20 more clients' is not clickable; no search, sort or filter. '22 OK' with 2 needing attention out of 25 does not add up (23).
defects.fix: Add a client search box at the top of the sidebar, a scrollable full list, filters (needs attention / framework), and make the counts consistent (23 OK · 2 need attention).

defects.issue: No cross-client view: he must click each client to find open incidents, which is the tool-sprawl he wants to escape.
defects.fix: Add an 'All clients' entry at the top of the sidebar giving a combined incident queue and not-reporting list across clients, with client column.

defects.issue: No PSA/RMM tie-in (ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, NinjaOne) or ticket numbers on incidents.
defects.fix: Show 'PSA ticket #48213 · ConnectWise' on each incident and a 'Push to PSA' button; list connected integrations in Partner settings.

defects.issue: Phone: client drawer opens with no scrim and no close button; the live page shows through on the right and can be tapped; the sim screenshot shows the drawer stuck half-open mid-transition after switching.
defects.fix: Add a dimmed backdrop that closes on tap, a close (X) button, Esc to close, focus trap, and return focus to the toggle.

defects.issue: Analyst on duty 'until 18:00 ET' with no handover shown; 24/7 night cover is his main reason to buy.
defects.fix: Show 'Now: Rosa K. (until 18:00 ET) · Next: Sam T. (18:00-02:00)' and 'Escalation phone 24/7'.

defects.issue: Persona needs margin per client; Partner shows only totals across 25 clients.
defects.fix: Add a per-client table: client, endpoints, wholesale, resale price (editable), margin $ and %, with totals row.

defects.issue: Pricing models conflict: bottom bar says 'Plan: flat $999/mo up to 100 endpoints' while Partner bills per endpoint at $6. Sunrise has 120 endpoints, above the 100 cap. The MSP's suggested resale ($12/endpoint, $768 for BrightSmile) is below the direct flat price for small clients but above it for 100-endpoint clients ($1,200 vs $999), so a client could buy direct for less: a channel conflict an MSP owner will spot immediately.
defects.fix: Show one pricing model per role: partners see wholesale per-client pricing and no direct price; hide the direct plan from MSP-managed and white-labelled tenants; explain the partner discount vs direct and add channel protection ('clients you register cannot buy direct').

defects.issue: 'Your margin 50%' and '$9,750 / month' under the same label read as two different metrics; the '$9,750' is also identical to wholesale cost, which is easy to misread.
defects.fix: Split into 'Gross profit $9,750/mo' and 'Margin 50%', and show annualised recurring revenue.

defects.issue: White-label is a static 'On' pill with no preview, logo, domain or email-sender settings, while client-facing screens still say 'Watchpost' and show 'W' logo.
defects.fix: Add a white-label card with logo upload, colour, domain status (DNS verified), report branding preview, and a 'Preview as client' button that renders the client view with the MSP's brand.

defects.issue: Rail 'Settings' icon opens the Partner tab; the label does not match the destination.
defects.fix: Give Partner its own rail icon (handshake / dollar) and keep Settings for account settings.

defects.issue: Nothing on client retention: no QBR/business review export, renewal dates, or client health trend.
defects.fix: Add 'Generate QBR deck for this client' and a client health trend sparkline in the per-client table.

defects.issue: Changing the framework dropdown changes only the title and score; the control list still shows HIPAA citations (§164.312 etc.) under CMMC Level 1, FTC Safeguards and PCI DSS.
defects.fix: Swap the control list per framework with the right citations (e.g. FTC 314.4(c)(8) logging, CMMC AC.L1-b.1.i, PCI 10.x).

defects.issue: Only 5 of 20 controls listed; no 'show all', no control owner, no last-evidence date, no link to the evidence item.
defects.fix: List all controls with status, evidence source, last collected date and owner; make each row expandable to show the evidence file.

defects.issue: 'Audit controls: logs kept 1 year' marked Met. HIPAA requires documentation kept 6 years and auditors will challenge 1-year log retention as proof.
defects.fix: State retention plainly with an option ('Logs: 1 year online, 6-year archive available') and mark as partially met if not archived.

defects.issue: No BAA status, though a HIPAA buyer must have a Business Associate Agreement with the MDR vendor.
defects.fix: Add 'BAA signed: Yes, Mar 2 2026 · Download' at the top of the HIPAA view.

defects.issue: Framework list ignores the org: Sunrise Credit Union is 'NCUA' but NCUA/GLBA is not in the dropdown; BrightSmile is HIPAA but defaults show all frameworks.
defects.fix: Default to the org's frameworks, add NCUA/GLBA, and let the user add frameworks.

defects.issue: 'Export evidence for auditor' gives only a toast; no format, scope (date range, framework) or history of past exports; no read-only auditor share.
defects.fix: Open an export dialog (framework, period, format ZIP/PDF index) and add 'Share read-only link with auditor (expires in 30 days)'. Show 'Last exported Oct 2'.

defects.issue: Training records 'Upload needed' appears in Compliance and 'Upload certificate' in Insurance but there is no upload control.
defects.fix: Add one upload action that satisfies both, and show it fulfilled in both tabs.

defects.issue: 'Questionnaire readiness 9 of 10' but only 4 questions are shown.
defects.fix: Show all 10 questions (or 'Showing 4 of 10 · View all') so the count can be checked.

defects.issue: 'MFA on email and remote access? Yes · 62/64 users' is shown green; insurers require all users, so 2 gaps should be a warning. 'users' also mixes with '64 endpoints' elsewhere.
defects.fix: Show 'Partly · 2 users without MFA' in amber with the names and a fix link; keep users and devices counts clearly separate.

defects.issue: Carrier is a placeholder ('your current insurer'); no policy number, coverage limit, premium or broker contact.
defects.fix: Show carrier, policy no., limit, current premium and broker name/email, and an 'Email pack to broker' button.

defects.issue: No cost view for finance: no invoice, plan, next bill or how the price is fixed, and the only price shown (bottom bar $999/mo) conflicts with Sunrise's 120 endpoints.
defects.fix: Add a Billing card (in Insurance or a Billing tab): plan, endpoints vs cap, next invoice, 'Price locked until', download invoices.

defects.issue: No business-case numbers: premium impact or breach cost avoided, which is what the CFO takes to the renewal.
defects.fix: Add 'Controls that typically lower premiums' and a simple 'Estimated breach cost for a practice your size' note with source.

defects.issue: Right bar on the Insurance tab shows analyst on duty and server-patch tasks, which are irrelevant to finance.
defects.fix: Make the right bar contextual: on Insurance show renewal timeline, missing documents checklist and broker contact.

global_defects.issue: Right side bar is identical on every tab (analyst, next actions, response promise, October report) and does not change with the selected client.
global_defects.fix: Make the right bar contextual per tab and per org: Overview = analyst + next actions; Incidents = incident timeline / analyst notes; Devices = agent install help; Compliance = audit dates, BAA, auditor contact; Insurance = renewal checklist + broker; Partner = billing and white-label settings.

global_defects.issue: Only Overview is driven by ORGS data; all other panels, the summary, the rail badge (2) and right bar are static BrightSmile content.
global_defects.fix: Store per-org incidents, devices, controls, insurance and actions and re-render every panel on onSelect.

global_defects.issue: MSP console and single-business customer view are merged, which confuses every non-MSP persona and leaks MSP margins/direct pricing to white-label clients.
global_defects.fix: Add a role/view switch (Business view vs Partner view) in the rail avatar menu; hide the client list and Partner tab in Business view.

global_defects.issue: Numbers that do not reconcile: '22 OK' vs 25 clients with 2 needing attention; Harbor '85/88' with '4 not reporting'; 3 threats stopped vs 2 threats listed; 9 of 10 answers with 4 shown; '2 critical patches' that is one patch on 2 servers; $999 flat up to 100 endpoints vs a 120-endpoint client.
global_defects.fix: Compute derived numbers from the data in script, and run a consistency check in the sim harness.

global_defects.issue: Phone: sidebar and right-bar drawers have no backdrop, no close button, no focus trap or Esc handling; the tab bar overflows (688px in 390px) with no visual affordance; bottom bar takes 3 lines of permanent space above the rail.
global_defects.fix: Add scrim + close buttons + Esc + focus trap; add edge fade or a 'More' overflow menu for tabs; collapse the bottom bar to one line on phone (status dot + 'Monitoring live').

global_defects.issue: Accessibility: tabs lack aria-controls and panels lack role=tabpanel/aria-labelledby; incident buttons lack aria-expanded and the detail is not announced; severity conveyed by colour only; --faint #8a919c on white (~3.2:1) used for 12px section headings, '+20 more clients' and the analyst hours fails WCAG AA.
global_defects.fix: Add aria-controls/role=tabpanel, aria-expanded on incident rows with an aria-live detail region, text severity labels, and darken --faint to at least #6b7280 (4.6:1).

global_defects.issue: Rail items are mislabelled or dead: 'Settings' opens Partner, 'Search' only shows a toast, the Compliance icon is labelled 'reports'.
global_defects.fix: Map each rail icon to a matching destination; add a real search panel and a Settings page (users, notifications, integrations).

global_defects.issue: No user/notification management: who receives alerts, by what channel (SMS, email, phone), escalation contacts after hours.
global_defects.fix: Add a Settings view with contacts per role and escalation order, and show 'You get alerts by SMS + email' in the right bar.

global_defects.issue: Wireframe fidelity: wireframe main content has a row of three image cards and a bottom call-to-action card; the right bar has a list, an image/chart block and a list. Mockup has no chart anywhere (no trend of threats or coverage over time).
global_defects.fix: Add a small 30-day trend chart (alerts reviewed vs escalated, or coverage %) in the right bar or Overview, matching the wireframe's media block.

missing_personas.role: MSP account manager / vCIO running client business reviews
missing_personas.cares_about: Renewals, upsells and showing each client the value of the security line item.
missing_personas.time_spent: Quarterly business reviews, proposals, client calls.
missing_personas.struggles: Turning technical data into a client-ready story; assembling QBR decks by hand from several tools.
missing_personas.how_helps: One-click branded QBR/report per client with plain-English outcomes, trends and recommendations.
missing_personas.task: Select a client, open the Partner/Reports view and generate a white-labelled quarterly review PDF with threats stopped, coverage and open recommendations.

missing_personas.role: Practice / branch operations manager responsible for staff onboarding and offboarding
missing_personas.cares_about: Staff leaving do not keep access; new staff are working on day one.
missing_personas.time_spent: HR paperwork, scheduling, onboarding/offboarding staff accounts with IT.
missing_personas.struggles: Forgotten accounts of ex-employees; no visibility of who still has access.
missing_personas.how_helps: Lists dormant/ex-employee accounts and admin changes with a one-click 'disable request'.
missing_personas.task: Open an 'Accounts' view, find accounts unused for 30+ days and send a disable request to IT.

missing_personas.role: HIPAA auditor or CMMC third-party assessor (C3PAO) with read-only access
missing_personas.cares_about: Verifiable, timestamped evidence mapped to controls, without chasing the client.
missing_personas.struggles: Screenshots without provenance; evidence arriving late and incomplete.
missing_personas.how_helps: Time-limited read-only auditor link with control-by-control evidence and an export log.
missing_personas.task: Open a shared read-only link, filter to CMMC Level 1, open a control and download its evidence with collection timestamp.

missing_personas.cares_about: Accurate answers on MFA, EDR, backups and incident history to place and price cover.
missing_personas.time_spent: Collecting questionnaires and chasing clients before renewal dates.
missing_personas.struggles: Self-attested answers they cannot verify; late submissions.
missing_personas.how_helps: Broker-shared pack with live, dated evidence and an attestation from the provider.
missing_personas.task: Open the shared insurance pack, check the MFA/EDR/backup answers and their evidence dates, and download the signed attestation.

missing_personas.role: Outside counsel or privacy officer handling breach notification
missing_personas.cares_about: Knowing quickly whether an incident is a reportable breach (HIPAA 60-day, state laws, FTC Safeguards 30-day notice for 500+ consumers).
missing_personas.time_spent: Contracts, privacy notices, incident response calls.
missing_personas.struggles: Unclear facts on what data was accessed and when; deadlines start before they are told.
missing_personas.how_helps: Each incident shows whether regulated data was touched, a timeline and a notification-deadline indicator.
missing_personas.task: Open an incident and see 'Patient data accessed: No', the event timeline and whether a notification clock has started.

missing_personas.role: Front-desk or shop-floor employee who reports suspicious email
missing_personas.cares_about: Not getting blamed; knowing quickly whether an email is safe.
missing_personas.struggles: Does not know whom to tell; fears clicking something bad.
missing_personas.how_helps: A 'Report suspicious email' button / mobile page with a fast plain-English verdict from analysts.
missing_personas.task: On phone, report a suspicious email and see the analyst verdict and what to do.
